Name: NPCs as Chests
Author: sproggen
Description:
NPCs will gladly take care of your belongings with this *chest retexture* for Alternative Textures. This mod requires Alternative Textures to work, you can find it listed in the required files below.

Notes:
They still have the default chest creak sound when "opened" and the NPCs do not move unless you interact with them. They each have new custom animations upon "opening".

I personally use this for a market-themed farm so most of the NPCs are traders or merchants from across the game, they're also good for placing around the world instead of clunky wooden chests. Enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Make sure you have the required "Alternative Textures" mod installed. Unzip "NPCs as Chests" and drag the unzipped content to your Mods folder. Use the AT paintbrush tool to retexture chests in-game.
